summary: Frontend-only test of Phase 2 Plasma Energy Flow + firmware hints. All 6 scenarios pass. Dashboard SVG renders all 4 nodes (PV 259W AC/DC sub, Netz, Akku with SoC ring + '42% · ↑129 ↓232W', Haus). Hover highlights related flows (opacity 1 vs 0.28/0.3 for unrelated) and shows value pills (hover PV -> 2 pills, hover Haus -> 3 pills). Dynamic nodes: disabling shelly hides flow-grid; disabling trucki hides flow-battery; disabling ahoy+victron hides flow-pv. All 4 devices RE-ENABLED and saved at end. Firmware chips show on Ahoy + Victron only, hidden on Shelly + Trucki. Expanded Ahoy shows 'Update verfügbar → v0.8.150', Shelly shows 'Aktuell'. Chips persist after /geraete reload (GET /api/devices/info). Mobile viewport 390x844: no horizontal overflow on Dashboard or Geräte; SVG scales to 308px width. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: EnergyFlow.jsx reversePath/pathMid only handle single L segments; fine for current straight-line flows but will silently break if curved paths (Q/C) are introduced.
seed_data_creation: None. Devices toggled during test and all re-enabled + saved at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 Energy Flow + firmware hints verified end-to-end via real Playwright including hover state and dynamic node show/hide. Devices left in default state (all 4 enabled).
